title: Mouse mode chip
description: An ambient 🖱 chip in a terminal's title bar, shown for exactly as long as a full-screen app owns the mouse (lazygit/btop/mc), with the escape gesture in its tooltip — Shift-drag to select, Option-drag on macOS, Shift+scroll for scrollback. Rides ctx.windows.onTerminalCreate and samples xterm's mouseTrackingMode; no click action, no settings.
author: JohnConnorNPC
